rrnXuCWh_4uZW0Gy21qSVA.zh: 賴索托中部塔巴采卡(Thaba-Tseka)區報告8例確定病例,分別為4名男童及4名成年男性,其中1名6歲男童死亡,其餘住院治療中;該國近期曾向世界動物衛生組織(WOAH)通報牛隻之炭疽病疫情,當局提醒民眾應避免食用不明原因死亡之動物肉品,倘有疑病例應立即向當地獸醫或衛生部門通報。
rrnXuCWh_4uZW0Gy21qSVA.en: Eight confirmed cases were reported in Thaba-Tseka district in central Lesotho: four boys and four adult men. One six-year-old boy died, and the others are hospitalized. Lesotho recently notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) of an anthrax outbreak in cattle. Authorities advise the public to avoid eating meat from animals that died of unknown causes, and to report any suspected cases immediately to local veterinary or health authorities.
